gate-policy-override.description: Explicit user authorization for a scope-bound gate tier or reviewer-coverage downgrade. Execution mode is selected directly by the user and is not an override coordinate.
gate-policy-override.title: Gate tier and coverage downgrade override

gate-reviewer-result.description: A schema-complete selected-reviewer report bound to one immutable gate scope manifest. Coverage declaration calibrates the review; it does not claim semantic or defect completeness.
gate-reviewer-result.title: Gate Reviewer Result

gate-scope-manifest.description: Immutable, bounded declaration of the repository scope supplied to selected gate reviewers.

reference_index.description: Optional on legacy v1 artifacts; current producers emit this immutable subject/base snapshot index and reviewer protocols bind every evidence reference to it.

gate-scope-manifest.title: Gate scope manifest

gate-synthesis-result.description: Deterministic synthesis parity contract for selected-reviewer findings, declared coverage, and the initial remediation closure seed.
gate-synthesis-result.title: Gate synthesis result

gate-verification.description: Three-axis assessment of gate artifact integrity, subject freshness, and consumer applicability.
gate-verification.title: Gate artifact verification
